draw.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(seed), one stream, draw order translation xyz, mass, friction per seed

normalization.note: The reference is the jaw arm's whole-body reach and aperture, so its normalized world coincides with the fixed one to within the environment's own scaling rule.
normalization.rule: EnvironmentV1.scaled_to: lengths by reach over reference reach, object size by aperture over reference aperture, mass by volume, capped at payload

success.definition: attempt_transfer certifies: hidden-weld/object-actuator/exclusion policy clean, opposition established, lifted at least 0.8 object heights, held continuously 2.0 s, carried within 2.5 apertures of the grasp centre, released with no robot contact or normal force, whole geometry inside the destination region and still for 2.0 s, penetration at most 4 mm, no self-collision
success.enabled_set_rule: bodies the independent feasibility map classes feasible; an infeasible body is attempted once and its typed refusal recorded; a body without a grasping effector is recorded as unsupported by structure
success.target: at least 90 of 100 registered trials per feasible body
